name: Ben Hadad
overview: Ben Hadad was a king of Syria who played a significant role during the reigns of Israelite kings such as Asa and Ahab. Scripture records his involvement in political and military alliances, including receiving gifts from King Asa to break a league with Baasha of Israel, which led to military actions against Israelite cities. Later, Ben Hadad, identified as the son of Tabrimon and king at Damascus, fell ill, prompting his servant Hazael to seek counsel from the prophet Elisha about his recovery. These accounts highlight Ben Hadad's position as a key figure in the regional power dynamics and God's sovereign involvement in the affairs of earthly rulers.
